stories.title: Coroner: Grizzlies' Clarke died from drug mixture
stories.summary: Memphis Grizzlies forward Brandon Clarke died from "the effects of heroin and cocaine," the Los Angeles County medical examiner's office announced Friday.

stories.title: Raiders' Cousins, Crosby scuffle at Friday practice
stories.summary: Raiders quarterback Kirk Cousins and star pass rusher Maxx Crosby got into a scuffle late in practice Friday before their teammates quickly jumped in and separated them.

stories.title: Sources: Titans' Skoronski gets $100M extension
stories.summary: The Titans have signed Peter Skoronski to a four-year, $100 million extension, making him the highest-paid guard in the NFL, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: UConn's Hurley sounds alarm on late additions
stories.summary: UConn head coach Dan Hurley said coaches who are taking advantage of recent court rulings to make late additions to their programs are doing more harm than good.

stories.title: Red Sox's Tolle fans career-high 14 in rout vs. A's
stories.summary: Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 in six innings, Wilyer Abreu drove in three runs, and the Boston Red Sox won their ninth game in a row Friday.
